name: shortcut-button
title: Shortcut button
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A button whose keycaps depress while its keyboard shortcut is held, then runs the command.

meta.descriptionEs: Un botón cuyas teclas se hunden mientras se mantiene el atajo, y luego ejecuta el comando.

examples.title: Botón con atajo
examples.description: Un botón cuyas teclas se hunden mientras se mantiene el atajo, y luego ejecuta el comando.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320px, texto largo, y lectura de derecha a izquierda.

api.name: shortcut
api.description: Combination such as mod+s or mod+k. mod is Command on Apple and Control elsewhere. Default mod+s.

api.name: onCommand
api.description: Runs when the shortcut completes or the button is clicked.

api.name: showShortcut / preventDefault
api.description: Show the keycaps. preventDefault defaults to true.

docs: Adapted from Evil Buttons command-button (Apache-2.0, radiumcoders, commit ec0fa86f8d06). Colors use the host button. Key travel is removed when the reader prefers reduced motion. See NOTICE. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
